description: This file implements factory functions and classes for creating resource grid objects, resource grid pools, resource grid mappers, and PRACH buffers, primarily used in a wireless communication system, with specific focus on 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: resource_grid_factory_impl
classes.description: Factory class for creating resource grid objects.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper_factory_impl
classes.description: Factory class for creating resource grid mapper objects.

methods.name: create_resource_grid_mapper_factory
